• Company Defining Delivery: Delivered a 350,000 sf data center for a customer; successfully led breaking ground to dried-in structure in 5 months while maintaining original 12 month schedule budget

I love many things about business: working with people, helping teams find solutions to complex problems, analyzing technical issues, controlling finances, leading teams, mitigating risk, and driving individuals and teams towards end results. I have been fortunate to get to apply these strengths and abilities in my career in the construction and real estate development industry.
